label: RV-EV-04
command_argv:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,yaml
root=Path.cwd()
p=root/'handoffs/evaluator_executor/HNA-RESEARCH-ADMISSION-20261116'
c=root/'handoffs/evaluator_executor/HNA-EVIDENCE-REOPEN-20261116'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
idx=json.loads((p/'evidence/preparation_delivery_index.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert all(sha(root/x['path'])==x['sha256'] for x in idx['artifacts'])
assert all(sha(p/name)==v for name,v in idx['unchanged_contract_dependencies'].items())
b=json.loads((p/'evidence/planning_r2_baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert all(sha(root/path)==v for path,v in b['source_hashes'].items())
links=[]
for path in [p/'REVIEW.md',p/'PREPARATION_REVIEW.md',c/'CONTRACT.md']:
 s=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 for ref in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',s):
  if ref.startswith(('http:','https:','#')):continue
  assert (path.parent/ref).is_file(),(str(path),ref)
  links.append(ref)
 s.encode('utf-8')
contract=(c/'CONTRACT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
acs=set(re.findall(r'^### (AC-\d{2})',contract,re.M))
plan=yaml.safe_load((c/'VALIDATION_PLAN.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert acs==set(a for x in plan['checks'] for a in x['ac'])
assert plan['task_id']=='HNA-EVIDENCE-REOPEN-20261116'
compile(plan['checks'][0]['command'][-1],'<draft_receipt_check>','exec')
assert not (c/'evidence/reopen_receipt.json').exists()
register=json.loads((p/'evidence/task_register.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert register['eligible_effect_task_count']==0 and not register['reference_register_frozen']
print(json.dumps({'executor_artifacts_preserved':len(idx['artifacts']),'source_files_preserved':len(b['source_hashes']),'parent_contract_and_plan_preserved':True,'local_links_checked':len(links),'next_task_kind':'evaluator_design','next_task_state':'DRAFT_CONTRACT','next_task_executed':False,'reference_tasks_frozen':False,'new_effect_task_count':0},ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
